system.description:
Once per round, when you land a hit in melee on a creature no more than one size larger than you, you may put your full weight behind the blow: you deal your damage and also shove the target 10ft away from you along the ground. Being shoved never provokes Attacks of Opportunity.

Available to: Fighters, Barbarians, Knights, Paladins, Magi, Bards, Rangers, Archers, Gunslingers, Swashbucklers, Rogues, Assassins, and Monks.
